title: Unconnected SendRRData analogue with Null Address Item and bounded GetAttributeList plus socket info
purpose: Exercise the unconnected explicit-message path cited by the issue using the documented Null Address Item plus Unconnected Data Item combination, while keeping the GetAttributeList request small and adding optional socket-address items for response-assembly coverage.

messages.label: RegisterSession response template with session handle 0x00000001
SendRRData with Null Address Item, Unconnected Data Item carrying small GetAttributeList, and two socket address items

expected_behavior: Target should parse SendRRData, accept the Null Address Item and Unconnected Data Item, traverse the embedded request, and either return a normal response or a clean CIP error. Optional socket-address items should be parsed as additional CPF items without destabilizing response assembly.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation command 0x006f and 24-byte header format follow supplied EtherNet/IP reference.

CPF item count is 4 and includes the documented common SendRRData pair of Null Address Item 0x0000 and Unconnected Data Item 0x00b2, plus additional socket address items observed in supplied issue evidence.
Null Address Item length is zero as documented by item structure semantics.
GetAttributeList-style payload is intentionally small: service 0x03 with a compact path and attribute count 2 instead of the issue's dangerous high count.
Socket address item bodies use 16-byte sockaddr-like layouts as conservative inferred assumptions from issue text; exact subfield semantics are not claimed as source-verified.
issue_safety_notes: Avoids the historical corruption pattern by using only two repeated attribute IDs, bounded total lengths, and non-identical IP/port values; it is structurally similar but not a crash payload copy.
